overview_description.description: Study Edge is a leading education company that develops and distributes customized content for courses at the middle-school, high-school, and collegiate levels, in partnership with universities, state education agencies, and other institutions. Study Edge has contracts with top colleges and universities and with education agencies in Florida, Alabama, New York City, Mississippi, Michigan, South Carolina, and Texas on various educational initiatives.
